summary: Produced the code-cited capability inventory at scratch/competitive/A-our-capabilities.md (6 dimensions, every claim file:line-anchored, maturity-rated measured/built/prototype). Five strongest code-backed capabilities: (1) bi-temporal KB — valid-time + transaction-time + supersede chains, composable asOf/knownAsOf queries (overlay.js:222-262, daemon.js:1152-1180), MEASURED as-of retrieval 1.0 vs 0.6 recall@5; (2) fully local semantic search — MiniLM 384-dim in-process, no API/vector-DB (lib/embed.js), recall@5 0.91/MRR 0.82; (3) two-tier context handoff over typed weighted edges layered on NATIVE Claude Code tasks with write-through sync (native-tasks.js); (4) lease-guarded parallel attempt worktrees + CAS claim semantics + no-ff conflict-safe merge (git.js); (5) daemon-dumb/agent-smart self-learning loop — judge queue, measure/optimize deterministic controller, hold-merge verdicts. Honest measured evidence: token cost ON/OFF 1.63x→1.03x (work parity, cost=payload), v5 grounded-context made ON do ~1.29x MORE work (win-regime is narrow), held-out memory wins cold 0/10 & 0/8 vs warm 8.75/10 & 8/8 zero-variance, gate regret 0 (~690k tok-eq avoided), winnable slice ~23%. Key caveat: context-need gate is offline-validated PROTOTYPE — not wired into the daemon's live path.

item.value: Bi-temporal KB is real and two-axis in code: valid-time (validFrom/validTo, backdatable) + transaction-time (created_at, never backdated) at lib/overlay.js:222-240; composable /search?asOf&knownAsOf at daemon.js:1152-1180; supersede chains never delete (overlay.js:249-277). Measured: as-of retrieval recall@5 1.0 vs 0.6 flat-KB baseline (bench/temporal/report.json).

Embeddings are fully local: transformers.js + Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX 384-dim, no hosted API, no vector DB (lib/embed.js:21-26, weights cached in models/). embed() null => lexical fallback, retrieval never hard-fails. Retrieval quality measured: recall@5 0.91, MRR@5 0.82 over 28 queries (bench/retrieval/scorecard.md, PASS).

MEASURED-vs-BUILT split for competitive claims: MEASURED = token parity (1.63x->1.03x lean payload), over-deliberation tax (v5 ON did ~1.29x MORE hardness; v7 DAG+RAG worst at 2x), held-out memory wins (cold 0/10 & 0/8 vs warm 8.75/10 & 8/8, zero variance), gate regret 0 (~690k tok-eq avoided), winnable slice ~23% (12/52). BUILT-not-benchmarked = self-learn loop end-to-end, worktree parallelism, autonomy quality. PROTOTYPE = context gate in live path (daemon.js does NOT import lib/context-gate.js — offline-evaluated only).

Memory win-regime boundary (the honest pitch): retrieved memory is load-bearing IFF knowledge is (1) empirical, (2) external to the artifact, (3) project-local (pretraining-covered facts gave 0/4 trap survival). Production is naturally held-out; in-worktree tests/deps are an oracle leak that invalidated every v1-v8 cold baseline. Source: bench/MEMORY-RAG-FINDINGS.md sections 4-6.

Architecture differentiators with code anchors: (a) overlays NATIVE Claude Code tasks read-live + write-through with format-drift detection (lib/native-tasks.js:56-109) rather than a replacement task store; (b) typed context/blocking/supersede edges with weights, context never blocks (daemon.js:791, overlay.js:103-118); (c) two-tier handoff get_dependency_summaries/get_task_detail (daemon.js:1813/1881); (d) lease-guarded attempt worktrees + no-ff conflict-safe merge (lib/git.js:60-79,161-175); (e) CAS claim semantics, collisions are 409s (daemon.js:1486-1490); (f) daemon-dumb/agent-smart judge pipeline with epoch-watermarked queue (lib/judge.js:77-152).
